SC-2025-S1236.title: Dr. Byron L. Battle Sr. Pastoral Anniversary
SC-2025-S1236.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE DR. BYRON L. BATTLE SR. UPON THE OCCASION OF HIS FIFTH ANNIVERSARY AS PASTOR OF TABERNACLE BAPTIST CHURCH AND TO COMMEND HIM FOR HIS MANY YEARS OF SERVICE TO HIS CONGREGATION AND THE GREENVILLE COMMUNITY.
SC-2025-S1236.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1236.aiSummary: The Senate adopted a resolution to congratulate Dr. Byron L. Battle Sr. on his fifth anniversary as pastor of Tabernacle Baptist Church. It also commends him for his many years of service to his congregation and the Greenville community.

SC-2025-H5809.title: Clinton High School baseball team
SC-2025-H5809.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO RECOGNIZE AND HONOR THE CLINTON HIGH SCHOOL BASEBALL TEAM, COACHES, AND SCHOOL OFFICIALS ON AN OUTSTANDING 2026 SEASON, AND TO CONGRATULATE THEM FOR WINNING THE CLASS AA STATE BASEBALL CHAMPIONSHIP TITLE.
SC-2025-H5809.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5809.aiSummary: The resolution recognizes and honors the Clinton High School baseball team, coaches, and school officials for an outstanding 2026 season. It also congratulates them for winning the Class AA state baseball championship title.

SC-2025-H5802.title: Irmo Insurance Agency, 50th anniversary
SC-2025-H5802.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO RECOGNIZE IRMO INSURANCE AGENCY AT THE CELEBRATION OF ITS FIFTIETH ANNIVERSARY OF SERVICE IN SOUTH CAROLINA AND TO CONGRATULATE THE COMPANY ON A HALF-CENTURY OF SUCCESSFUL BUSINESS ENDEAVORS IN THIS GREAT STATE.
SC-2025-H5802.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5802.aiSummary: A House resolution would recognize Irmo Insurance Agency on its 50th anniversary of service in South Carolina. It would also congratulate the company on 50 years of business in the state.

SC-2025-H5795.title: Katherine Liles, sympathy
SC-2025-H5795.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO EXPRESS THE PROFOUND SORROW OF THE SOUTH CAROLINA HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES UPON THE PASSING OF KATHERINE LILES, A NATIVE OF MONCKS CORNER, TO CELEBRATE HER LIFE, AND TO EXTEND THE DEEPEST SYMPATHY TO HER FAMILY AND MANY FRIENDS.
SC-2025-H5795.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5795.aiSummary: The House adopted a resolution to express sorrow over the death of Katherine Liles, celebrate her life, and extend sympathy to her family and friends. The resolution honors her as a native of Moncks Corner.

SC-2025-H5641.title: Florence Memorial Stadium Commission
SC-2025-H5641.summary: AN ACT TO REPEAL ACT 989 OF 1948 RELATING TO THE CREATION OF THE FLORENCE MEMORIAL STADIUM COMMISSION. - RATIFIED TITLE
SC-2025-H5641.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

actions.text: Read third time and sent to Senate
Introduced, read first time, placed on local & uncontested calendar

SC-2025-H5641.aiSummary: The act repeals the law that created the Florence Memorial Stadium Commission. It affects the commission created under the 1948 act. It became law on May 19, 2026.

SC-2025-H5060.title: St. John's Fire District
SC-2025-H5060.summary: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT 369 OF 1959, AS AMENDED, RELATING TO THE ST. JOHN'S FIRE DISTRICT, SO AS TO INCREASE THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE COMMISSION AND TO REVISE THE PROCUREMENT REQUIREMENTS OF THE DISTRICT; AND TO REPEAL SECTION 2 OF ACT 727 OF 1978 RELATING TO THE ADDITIONAL APPOINTMENT OF A MEMBER. - RATIFIED TITLE
SC-2025-H5060.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

actions.text: Read third time and sent to Senate
Introduced, read first time, placed on local & uncontested calendar

SC-2025-H5060.aiSummary: This act changes the St. John’s Fire District by adding more members to its commission and updating its buying rules. It also repeals a 1978 law section about adding one more member. It became effective on May 19, 2026.

SC-2025-S1229.title: Felicia Douglas Littlejohn
SC-2025-S1229.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO RECOGNIZE AUGUST 13, 2026, AS "MRS. FELICIA DOUGLAS LITTLEJOHN DAY" IN SOUTH CAROLINA AND TO COMMEND MRS. LITTLEJOHN FOR HER EXTRAORDINARY TWENTY-FIVE-YEAR CAREER PROMOTING FINANCIAL LITERACY, ECONOMIC EMPOWERMENT, CIVIC LEADERSHIP, AND THE WELL-BEING OF THE GREENVILLE COMMUNITY.
SC-2025-S1229.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1229.aiSummary: A Senate resolution recognizes August 13, 2026, as "Mrs. Felicia Douglas Littlejohn Day" in South Carolina. It also commends Mrs. Littlejohn for her 25-year career supporting financial literacy, economic empowerment, civic leadership, and the Greenville community. The resolution was introduced and adopted.

SC-2025-H5788.title: Alhaji Ibrahim Kabiru Masari

SC-2025-H5788.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5788.aiSummary: The House adopted a resolution to recognize and honor Alhaji Ibrahim Kabiru Masari, who serves as a special adviser to the president of Nigeria.

SC-2025-H5774.title: Pendleton 12U All-Star State Champions
SC-2025-H5774.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO RECOGNIZE THE PENDLETON RECREATION ASSOCIATION 12U ALL-STAR BASEBALL TEAM FOR THEIR HISTORIC 2026 SEASON, TO CONGRATULATE THEM FOR WINNING THE SOUTH CAROLINA D2 "0" ZONE STATE CHAMPIONSHIP TITLE, AND FOR ADVANCING TO THE WORLD SERIES IN MISSISSIPPI.
SC-2025-H5774.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5774.aiSummary: Lawmakers adopted a resolution to recognize the Pendleton Recreation Association 12U All-Star baseball team for its 2026 season. It also congratulates the team for winning the South Carolina D2 "0" Zone state championship and reaching the World Series in Mississippi.

SC-2025-H5767.title: St. Paul AME Church 150th anniversary
SC-2025-H5767.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO CELEBRATE THE JOYOUS OCCASION OF THE ONE HUNDRED FIFTIETH ANNIVERSARY OF ST. PAUL AFRICAN METHODIST EPISCOPAL CHURCH AND TO CONGRATULATE AND HONOR REVEREND ANDREW J. JORDAN AND THE CONGREGATION FOR THEIR YEARS OF FAITHFUL SERVICE TO THE CRESTON COMMUNITY.
SC-2025-H5767.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5767.aiSummary: The resolution celebrates the 150th anniversary of St. Paul African Methodist Episcopal Church. It also congratulates and honors Reverend Andrew J. Jordan and the church congregation for their years of service to the Creston community. The measure was introduced and adopted.

SC-2025-H5760.title: Rhiannon Wyatt, Teacher of the Year
SC-2025-H5760.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE RHIANNON WYATT OF PAULINE-GLENN SPRINGS ELEMENTARY SCHOOL UPON BEING NAMED 2026 SPARTANBURG COUNTY SCHOOL DISTRICT 6 TEACHER OF THE YEAR, TO EXPRESS APPRECIATION FOR HER DEDICATED SERVICE TO CHILDREN, AND TO WISH HER CONTINUED SUCCESS IN THE FUTURE.
SC-2025-H5760.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5760.aiSummary: The resolution congratulates Rhiannon Wyatt of Pauline-Glenn Springs Elementary School for being named the 2026 Spartanburg County School District 6 Teacher of the Year. It also expresses appreciation for her service to children and wishes her success in the future. The House adopted it on August 11, 2026.
